## Getting Started

[Sbn Cloud](https://sbn.com/cloud) is the easiest and fastest way to use Sbn yet, with full support for all your custom .NET code and integrations. You're up and running in less than a minute, and your life will be made easier with automated upgrades and a built-in deployment engine. We offer a free 14-day trial, no credit card needed.

If you want to DIY, then you can [download Sbn]((https://our.sbn.com/download)) either as a ZIP file or via NuGet. It's the same version of Sbn CMS that powers Sbn Cloud, but you'll need to find a place to host it yourself, and handling deployments and upgrades will be all up to you.

## Documentation

The documentation for Sbn CMS can be found [on Our Sbn](https://our.sbn.com/documentation/). The source for the Sbn docs is [open source as well](https://github.com/sbn/SbnDocs) and we're happy to look at your documentation contributions.

## Join the Sbn community

Our friendly community is available 24/7 at the community hub, we call ["Our Sbn"](https://our.sbn.com/). Our Sbn features forums for questions and answers, documentation, downloadable plugins for Sbn, and a rich collection of community resources.

Besides "Our", we all support each other also via Twitter: [Sbn HQ](https://twitter.com/sbn), [Release Updates](https://twitter.com/sbnproject), [#sbn](https://twitter.com/hashtag/sbn)


## Contributing

Sbn is contribution-focused and community-driven. If you want to contribute back to the Sbn source code, please check out our [guide to contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md).
